# terza-ui

> terza-ui is an Angular component library of finished, accessible components that take on the look of your design system through a documented style API and themes written in plain CSS.

Selectors use the `tz` prefix (for example `tz-button`); design tokens are CSS custom properties prefixed `--tz-`. Components are standalone and zoneless-compatible. The npm package is `terza-ui`.

## Docs

- [Overview](docs/overview.md): what the library is, its status and its conventions
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): installing the package and using a component
- [Roadmap](docs/roadmap.md): the phases of work and the components planned in each
